newsitem.title: USA: ADVANCED GAMING DISCUSSES DEBENTURE RIGHTS.
newsitem.headline: ADVANCED GAMING DISCUSSES DEBENTURE RIGHTS.

text.p: Advanced Gaming Technology Inc said Thursday that in an effort to eliminate recent volatility in the activity of its common stock, it is conducting discussions with a representative of the purchasers of approximately $6.7 million of convertible debentures recently issued by AGTI, in connection with a possible modification of the conversion rights of the debentures.

The discussions, if consummated, would give AGTI the right to repurchase the debentures at 120 percent of their principal amount during a lock-up period of nine months, during which period the debentures would no longer be exerciseable. AGTI also announced that, pending the consummation of such discussions or the resolution of questions relating to the issuance of the stock underlying the debentures, AGTI would not issue any stock on exercise of the debentures. The terms of the debentures permit conversions at any time at discounts from AGTI's common stock trading bid prices over a prescribed time period preceding the conversion.
The company said no assurance can be given as to whether such discussions will be consummated.
